title: The Deal Desk
subtitle: One corporate finance concept, one real deal, every day. AI-voiced.
description: A daily corporate finance podcast for students preparing for investment banking interviews. Each episode teaches one concept through a real deal, drills the interview questions you'll be asked, covers a real deal from the past week and ends with a five-question quiz. Marco, an M&A banker, explains; Sofia, a first-year student, asks the questions you would. AI-voiced: Marco and Sofia are fictional characters with AI-generated voices, and the scripts are written with AI and checked against public sources. Not investment advice.
